entries.title: 1 Timothy 5:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Rules to be observed in reproving. 3 Of widows. 17 Of elders. 23 A precept for Timothy's health. 24 Some men's sins go before unto judgment, and some men's follow after.
